text:
Jordan (Corva Systems): Hi team — procurement refuses to accept an invoice without an official sales order number and an authorized signature on file. They also asked for the VAT registration and billing contact. Can you hold invoicing until they provide a PO? Month-end crunch for them.

Alice (Support): Thanks — we can hold. @Sam can you confirm whether we can give them a proforma or if legal needs anything special?

Sam (AE): On it. Procurement emailed me: they want the order to use this format: SALES-ORDER-<COMPANY>-YYYYMMDD and an authorized signatory name. I'm attaching the signed SOW we have. @Marta FYI re: VAT handling.

Marta (Finance): If the customer insists on a PO we cannot finalize the official invoice. Options: 1) issue a proforma now marked "Pending PO" so procurement has a reference, 2) accept a card/prepayment (they previously declined), or 3) delay invoicing until PO arrives (may push recognition). Do they have established net terms? :thinking_face:

Jordan (Corva Systems): They won't do cards — corporate policy. They can generate a PO but procurement says it'll be dated when approved (likely Friday). They need pre-invoice numbers to match internal GL and cost center.

Alice (Support): Proforma seems safest. We'll mark clearly: "Proforma — Do not process as invoice. Final invoice issued only upon receipt of official PO." Is legal okay with that @Sam? :thumbsup:

Sam (AE): Legal okay with proforma for documentation only, as long as wording prevents accounting recognition. Example PO format they requested:

```
SALES-ORDER-CORVA-20260317
PO#: CORVA-PO-987654
Authorized: Jane Doe, CFO
```
I'll email procurement the proforma and the SOW. Also sending billing contact: billing@corva.example.com

Marta (Finance): Quick VAT note: they're UK-registered? We need VAT ID to apply reverse-charge. If they provide their VAT ID on the PO we'll store it and not charge VAT. If not, we'll include VAT per standard rules. Jordan, can you confirm VAT ID?

Jordan (Corva Systems): VAT is GB123456789. Procurement will include it on the PO. They also said invoice date must align with PO date.

Alice (Support): OK — I'll draft the proforma with amounts, VAT note, and a clear "Pending PO" header. Will include this checklist for procurement: PO number, authorized signatory, VAT ID, billing address, cost center.

Procurement Bot: Ticket created: PR-4521, subject "Corva - awaiting PO for invoice issuance". Assigned to Marta (Finance). SLA: 48h.

Marta (Finance): Noted. Workflow: once PO# is received we convert proforma -> final invoice, stamp with PO#, and send to procurement. If PO date differs from proforma date we'll regenerate invoice to match their requested date.

Sam (AE): I'll escalate internally if we don't have PO by end of day Friday. Jordan, please paste the procurement acknowledgement or expected PO email here so I can push.

Jordan (Corva Systems): Will do. Thanks everyone — I'll nudge procurement and update this thread with the PO or a firm timeline.

Alice (Support): Great — proforma will be sent to billing@corva.example.com and cc: procurement@corva.example.com, marked "Pending PO". I'll include the SOW reference and amounts to match their internal GL. :white_check_mark:

Marta (Finance): Once PO arrives leave a note in PR-4521 with the PO# and attach the signed PO PDF. We'll handle conversion.

Sam (AE): Thanks team. Jordan — appreciate the quick follow-up.

Jordan (Corva Systems): Thanks — I'll update soon.
